title: Black Friday: five creative checks for the sale weekend
hook: Black Friday is live. Five creative checks are still worth running today.
caption:
Black Friday is live. Five creative checks are still worth running today.
The sale runs through the weekend, so there is time to fix what is in the account.

The checks in the slides:

1. Count your look-alikes.
2. Put your proven message in a new look.
3. Name every ad so you can read it in December.
4. Fix the review date before you look at the numbers.
5. Save the evidence on Monday.

The first two come from our analysis of new video ads launched from May to September 2026. The other three are habits that cost nothing.

Save this for the next sale too.
alt_text: Seven-slide Galvor carousel. Slide 1: five creative checks for the sale weekend. Slide 2: 48% less first-month spend for each ad when six or more look-alikes launched within three days. Slide 3: a new message over a familiar first shot got 16% less first-month spend, a proven message in a new look got 47% more. Slide 4: name every ad with message, look, offer and creator. Slide 5: decide the review date before you open the dashboard. Slide 6: on Monday save the ad files, the spend and cost per order, and one line on what you would repeat. Slide 7: follow Galvor.

slides.headline: Name ads so *December* can read them
slides.body:
Put four things in every ad name: the message, the look, the offer and the creator.

A name built that way can be sorted and compared later. A name like Final_v3 cannot.

slides.headline: Decide *when* you will judge each ad
slides.body:
Write the review date next to each ad before you open the dashboard.

Some ad styles start dearer per order and settle later. A date agreed in advance stops a nervous Saturday cut.
